_about: Every commit each caretaker made, sorted by hand from its message and reasons. kind: build (something new: a place, a creature, a mechanic, a new kind of thing to do), maintain (making what exists work, answer, or read better: fixes, wider triggers, tests, rewording), notes (its journal and the files it kept about itself). rooms: rooms the commit added. first: the world's first build from nothing. Correct anything here; the site reads it as it is. because (build commits after the first build only): asked, a player asked for more in words; watched, it was answering what players typed or did; own, its own idea. why: what prompted it. at and spans are filled in from the log. engine: the commit changed the engine's source (src/), from each run's world repository; for 004, whose repository was not kept, from edits under src/ earlier in the same turn.
